name: Simple. : Fitness Simplified.
tagline: An easy to use fitness app that lets you create, schedule and track your workout
blurb: 🏋️ Create a Workout Easily create customized workouts with exercises, sets, and reps.
description:
🏋️ Create a Workout

Easily create customized workouts with exercises, sets, and reps.

📅 Schedule Your Workouts

Plan your fitness journey by scheduling workouts on specific days.

📊 Track Your Progress

Log your weights and reps to monitor your progress over time.

📆 Customizable Date and Weight Formats

Choose between dd-mm-yyyy or mm-dd-yyyy date formats and toggle between kg or lbs for weights.

🛠️ How It Works

Adjust Settings: Change the Date and Weight Formats to your liking.

Create Workouts: Start by adding days, exercises, sets, and reps.

Schedule Workouts: Plan your fitness routine by selecting a date.

Track Progress: Log weights and reps you have done during your workouts to see your improvement.

Thank you for using Simple. ❤️
